text: The stark glass and bright lights, coupled with the sense of ordered emptiness, fills me with curiosity and a hint of anticipation. Spaces designed for innovation and display always make me reflect on how environments shape our thoughts and intentions. I feel like I am on the cusp of discovery, surrounded by possibilities, yet also aware of the clinical detachment in such places—that delicate balance between inspiration and sterility. In this almost sacred space for ideas, I find both excitement and a yearning for deeper connection.
